song.author: Graham Kendrick
song.lyrics:
[V1] .A E A D A A E D A Far and near, hear the call, worship Him, Lord of all . D A A E D A Families of nations come, celebrate what God has done
[C1] . A A7 C# D Say it loud, say it strong, . B7 Bm A A Asus E Tell the world what God has done . A A7 C# D Say it loud praise His name, . B7 D E A Let the earth rejoice. The Lord reigns!
[V2] .A E A D A A E D A Deep and wide is the love heaven sent from above . D A A E D A God's own Son, for sinners died, calls again, He is alive
[V3] .A E A D A A E D A At His name, let praise begin, oceans roar nature sings . D A A For He comes to judge the earth . E D A In righteousness and in His truth
song.title: Say it loud
